text: Breaking: Our teenagers are secretly taking control of AI, and it's raising major red flags!

Unsupervised AI training by teenagers is leveraging complex neural networks, utilizing vast amounts of user-generated data, and fine-tuning machine learning models, creating an unprecedented level of AI autonomy.
As they push the boundaries of AI capabilities, they're unwittingly developing sophisticated algorithms that may soon surpass human oversight.
The implications are profound: these AI systems could one day become uncontrollable, with far-reaching consequences for global security and societal stability.
Will we be able to stop our future AI overlords before it's too late, or will we be the ones getting flagged?
